meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 引导你把 OpenClaw 里的身份、频道、定时任务等迁移到 NanoClaw v2:先探测并读出这些数据,和你讨论每项怎么搬,动手前先展示改动。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 我要从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2。
say.note: 触发迁移向导,先检测旧安装。

say.text: 执行 openclaw migration,先看看有哪些配置。
say.note: 运行发现脚本并汇总身份、频道、定时任务等。

say.text: import from OpenClaw,但每处改动先给我确认。
say.note: 迁移过程逐项征求同意,不静默复制。

howto.what_en: Walks the user through migrating their OpenClaw installation to NanoClaw v2: reads what's already there, discusses each item, and shows proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: I want to migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Starts the migration flow with discovery.

say_en.text: Run an openclaw migration and show what config exists.
say_en.note: Discovery script runs and summarizes the install.

say_en.text: Import from OpenClaw, but confirm each change before applying.
say_en.note: Migration is interactive; no silent copying.
